payload.reason: The evidence provides specific machine learning and deep learning methods used for Recognizing Question Entailment (RQE) in the context of question answering systems, particularly in the medical domain.

claims.text: Logistic Regression is used as a machine learning method for classifying question pairs into entailment or no-entailment.
Deep learning models, including those using GloVe word embeddings, are employed for RQE and have shown high accuracy on various datasets.
The study compares the performance of deep learning and logistic regression methods on multiple datasets, demonstrating their effectiveness in RQE tasks.
